description: §13.9.1 S475 rule 2: a locked pending cell whose initializer reads no cell loads once, on mount. Calling a client function that reads no cell (`one()`) is not a read, so the cell is not derived (no E-VALUE-SERVER-CALL): it loads "a" on mount. RUNTIME, sqlEngine "real".
rationale: §13.9.1 "The spelling decides the load": the initializer "reads cells" when it reads a cell directly or through a called function; rule 2: "locked + an initializer that reads no cell loads once, on mount". ruling:user-voice-scrml.md S475 "⭐ RULED — S475 owner questions, PA recs adopted wholesale" item 1.
